sources.title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next: How to Run Locally - unsloth.ai
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next is a new open-weight, 125B parameter MoE multimodal model from Qwen. Built on the new Qwen4 architecture, it supports a 262K context window and advanced reasoning. It can run locally on devices with 78GB RAM /unified memory without requiring GPU VRAM. The model outperforms Claude-4.6-Opus (Max) at agentic coding, vision, and chat. sources.title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next - GitHub
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next upgrades the model systematically along four aspects — attention, residual, embedding and optimization — improving model capability while further optimizing computational efficiency, model capacity and training stability: Attention A GDN + QSA hybrid architecture.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-Flash - QwenCloud
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-Flash is the latest multimodal model from the Qwen family, combining powerful reasoning and generation with remarkable speed. It natively supports a million-token context window, allowing it to process lengthy documents, entire codebases, and complex conversations in a single pass.

sources.snippet: Welcome to the GitHub repository of the Qwen3.5 open model series, including Qwen3.5, Qwen3.6, and the latest Qwen3.8. Here, you can find official information about Qwen3.8, post your questions (Issues), and share your ideas with the community (Discussions).

sources.title: Qwen3.8 - How to Run Locally | Unsloth Documentation
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8 is Qwen's new model family, featuring Qwen3.8- 27B, Qwen3.8- 2.4T-A95B and Qwen3.8- Max. Qwen3.8-27B has vision and reasoning capabilities, a 256K context window, and runs locally on 17GB RAM/VRAM setups. Qwen3.8 excels at agentic coding, vision and chat tasks, and can now run via Unsloth GGUFs, NVFP4 and Unsloth Desktop.
